reviewScope: Sentence-level review of all 25 first-full-batch summaries and TLDRs against exact supplied official-abstract evidence. Root authorized one narrowly supported sentence edit in this completed batch; no source files or other batches changed.
overallFinding: All 25 summaries are accepted against the supplied source evidence after one narrowly supported correction of a sufficient condition previously phrased as necessary. The batch supports continuing the run; unreviewed batches are outside this review.

issues.sourceEvidence: if inputs specific to each eye are locally correlated in their firing, and are not anticorrelated within an arbor radius, monocular cells will robustly form
issues.summarySentence: Inputs belonging to the same eye must have locally correlated firing and must not be anticorrelated within an arbor radius.
issues.explanation: The source gives sufficient conditions for column formation; the word must presents them as necessary conditions, which the abstract does not establish.
issues.suggestedReplacementSentence: In the reported sufficient conditions, inputs belonging to the same eye have locally correlated firing and are not anticorrelated within an arbor radius.

nonBlockingObservations: Short-source summaries, especially the parser and energy-landscape papers, repeat their central contribution to satisfy the three-paragraph requirement; no generic claims of impact or unsupported results were added.
The barn-owl abstract is truncated, and its summary clearly acknowledges that missing source detail.
Some historical source strings include OCR artifacts or introductory text; this review checks fidelity to the supplied source strings, not a new publisher/PDF recovery.

records.title: A Back-Propagation Algorithm with Optimal Use of Hidden Units
records.reviewNote: Activation-energy objective, Boolean architecture selection, phonetic labeling and logistic adaptation match the evidence.

records.title: A Massively Parallel Self-Tuning Context-Free Parser
records.reviewNote: Parser capabilities and example-based improvement are preserved; explains representation without claiming constant-time unbounded parsing. Short evidence leads to some repetition.

records.title: An Optimality Principle for Unsupervised Learning
records.reviewNote: Reconstruction objective and restricted nonlinear-network scope are preserved; no unsupported performance claims.

records.title: Analog Implementation of Shunting Neural Networks
records.reviewNote: Analog hardware properties, sensory processing, Lyapunov stability and adaptive-resonance use match the abstract.

records.title: Analyzing the Energy Landscapes of Distributed Winner-Take-All Networks
records.reviewNote: Keeps energy-landscape control strategies at suggestion level; explanatory expansion is repetitive but does not invent results.

records.title: Connectionist Learning of Expert Preferences by Comparison Training
records.reviewNote: Pairwise preferences, backgammon, smaller networks and consistent ordering match the source; no invented numerical gains.

records.title: Convergence and Pattern-Stabilization in the Boltzmann Machine
records.reviewNote: Constant temperature, recognized attraction regions, escape mechanism and performance bounds are accurately retained.

records.title: Digital Realisation of Self-Organising Maps
records.reviewNote: One million effective binary weights in 25 milliseconds is exact and properly distinguished from recognition accuracy.

records.title: Further Explorations in Visually-Guided Reaching: Making MURPHY Smarter
records.reviewNote: Four populations, prior direct model, new inverse differential kinematics and obstacle handling match the source.

records.title: GEMINI: Gradient Estimation Through Matrix Inversion After Noise Injection
records.reviewNote: First-hidden-layer noise injection, iterative matrix inversion, unknown nonlinearities and two simulations match the source.

records.title: Learning Sequential Structure in Simple Recurrent Networks
records.reviewNote: Limits perfect recognition to the studied finite-state grammar and accurately describes recurrent hidden-state analysis.

records.title: Models of Ocular Dominance Column Formation: Analytical and Computational Results
records.reviewNote: The sufficient correlation conditions are now explicitly identified as sufficient, matching the abstract. All other content was retained.

records.title: Neural Analog Diffusion-Enhancement Layer and Spatio-Temporal Grouping in Early Vision
records.reviewNote: Two-level diffusion/maxima feedback, multiscale visual tasks and shape invariances match the source.

records.title: Neural Approach for TV Image Compression Using a Hopfield Type Network
records.reviewNote: OCR-damaged source still supports metastable states, Minimal Overlap organization and adaptive image codebooks; no numerical results added.

records.title: Neural Net Receivers in Multiple Access-Communications
records.reviewNote: Preserves comparison against conventional receiver and does not claim optimal-receiver parity.

records.title: Neural Network Recognizer for Hand-Written Zip Code Digits
records.reviewNote: Correctly conditions low error on accepted samples and keeps cross-task applicability prospective.

records.title: Neural Network Star Pattern Recognition for Spacecraft Attitude Determination and Control
records.reviewNote: Speed and fault tolerance are explicitly presented as promises, not measured results.

records.title: Neural Networks for Model Matching and Perceptual Organization
records.reviewNote: Hierarchical graph matching, constrained optimization, analog networks and preliminary empirical status match the source.

records.title: Neuronal Maps for Sensory-Motor Control in the Barn Owl
records.reviewNote: Source is truncated; summary explicitly states that problem details and outcomes are unavailable, avoiding invented findings.

records.title: Optimization by Mean Field Annealing
records.reviewNote: One-to-two-order speed claim is correctly restricted to equilibrium at a given temperature; graph bipartitioning and critical-temperature analysis are retained.

records.title: Performance of Synthetic Neural Network Classification of Noisy Radar Signals
records.reviewNote: Accurately reports traditional classifiers outperform neural classifiers on five-aircraft recognition and separates future potential from findings.

records.title: Scaling and Generalization in Neural Networks: A Case Study
records.reviewNote: Majority-function case study is accurately scoped; does not invent sample sizes, rates or universal guarantees.

records.title: Statistical Prediction with Kanerva's Sparse Distributed Memory
records.reviewNote: Statistical interpretation near capacity and genetic-algorithm/storage enhancements remain proposed rather than demonstrated.

records.title: Temporal Representations in a Connectionist Speech System
records.reviewNote: 79 percent unseen recognition, six repetitions, 24 syllables and 100 percent training recognition match the source.

records.title: Winner-Take-All Networks of O(N) Complexity
records.reviewNote: Fabricated CMOS, continuous-time operation and O(n) interconnection complexity are correctly distinguished from running time.

edits.before: The results identify conditions under which monocular cells form robustly and cortical interactions organize them into columns. Inputs belonging to the same eye must have locally correlated firing and must not be anticorrelated within an arbor radius. Broader correlations within an eye, or anticorrelations between the eyes, make the resulting cortex more exclusively responsive to individual eyes.
